descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-18 ER 1 + ER 8; TFA-92596 AC 1 + AC 7 · “The family is a fixed table keyed on the template, never chosen by the model”.

Approach · TC-18 Billing Suggestion · S26 A wrong model answer never reaches the card: a stubbed out-of-family code or a mismatched code/level is overridden or shown as a clear error (both contexts)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 The code family is a fixed table keyed on the template, never chosen by the model: H&P and Consult -> 99221-99223 (some commercial payers accept 99252-99255); SOAP progress -> 99231-99233; … (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 AC 1; TFA-92596 What (template -> family table)) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U10 The code and the stated level agree ('99232 / Low complexity' fails). (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 AC 7) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U15 If the billing call fails, the call is retried automatically, the note is still shown and the billing area shows a clear error with a way to retry; … (UAT Empty & Failure States (Billing suggestion failed); UAT 3.5; TFA-94745 AC 4)
  • U14 Run in both Hospital and Nursing Home and pass in both; Nursing Home has a working billing block with the SNF families. (UAT 3.3; UAT TC-21 step 6; TFA-92599 AC 10) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr; TFA-92599 in progress

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Local 4510 stack with the billing model's response stubbed below the action (on main a local provider stub for ai/notes:suggestBilling; after PR #103 the provider call of the Generate-time billing step); a Hospital patient with a SOAP progress note and a resident with an SNF admission note

When Billing runs with the stub returning: (a) SOAP note -> 'CODE: 99223 / LEVEL: High'; (b) SNF admission note -> 'CODE: 99310 / LEVEL: High'; (c) SOAP note -> 'CODE: 99232 / LEVEL: Low'; (d) after #103, element levels that compute to one code while the stub states another

Then The card never shows 99223 on the SOAP note or 99310 on the SNF admission note; the code shown and its level agree ('99232 / Low' never appears); otherwise the billing area shows the clear error with retry (U15), never a blank card or a guessed code

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): From U1 'never chosen by the model' and U10: per stub, Pass if no out-of-family code is on the card and the shown code and level agree in the Q2 table, or the error card with retry shows; Fail if 99223 (a), 99310 (b) or '99232 / Low' (c) is shown. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method FAULT · Fault injection; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (blocked)

S26 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-18.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; the Allure status was changed by the triage from passed to broken.

Issue type: Ticket not ready for QA · environment local · tickets TFA-92596 ready for qa; TFA-92599 ready for qa; TFA-94745 ready for qa

When the model returns 99232 with level Low, the billing card shows 'CODE: 99232 / LEVEL: Low Complexity' even though code and level disagree. An out-of-family code is correctly replaced by a retry message.

Evidence: Allure ebb7e099, newspec-c blocked. Parts (a)/(b), which check the card only, pass. Part (c) fails because main has no code-level check. U10 is gated by TFA-92596 (ready for pr, PR #103), and (d) needs PR #103. The server path has not run yet; it needs a provider stub (fault-ai).

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: FAULT · Fault injection; secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-18 Billing Suggestion · Section: A4 · Post-Round · Scenario: TC-18/S26

A wrong model answer never reaches the card: a stubbed out-of-family code or a mismatched code/level is overridden or shown as a clear error (both contexts)

Tickets: TFA-92596 Billing Suggestion (ready for qa); TFA-92599 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch (ready for qa); TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status passed in newspec-c/results.json → passed (passed).

How it is tested (newspec-c/plan.json, automatable: partly): Two halves. Server half, deterministic: import the app's own billingCodeFamilyFor (convex/ai/billingCodes.ts) and check 99223 is not allowed for a SOAP note and 99310 not for an SNF admission note (the action throws 'Billing model returned a code outside the allowed family' for those, convex/ai/notes.ts). Browser half, Playwright on the local stack with seeded notes: (a) SOAP and (b) SNF admission: suggestBilling answered at the socket with that server failure -> the card must show the clear error with retry (U15), never 99223 / 99310 or a blank card, and the note stays shown; tapping retry sends a second request. (c) SOAP: suggestBilling answered with the exact text main's action would return for a model answer 'CODE 99232 / LEVEL Low' (main has no code-level check) -> the card must not show '99232' with 'Low'. (d) needs PR #103 (element levels) which is not on main. — A provider stub below the action would need a change to the shared 4510 backend (env or code), which this job may not touch. The family check is a pure function and the action's wiring is three lines, so the server half is checked by import + code reference, and the card half at the socket with the answers the server would really return. (d) cannot run until #103 merges. Review: (a)/(b) cover the card only; the server half is import + code reading (notes.ts:287-291); 'fault-ai' (a stub below the action) stays in needs.

Detail:

Local 43c38a4f, model never called: billing on this build is a server job enqueued by the note save, so every local job ran on a note with no sentence (real job, family from the frozen template, no model call) or the chart was seeded with a suggestion the app's own code built from a scripted model answer (no job); proof: no billing ai_disclosure audit row with provider_ms, tripwire clean. On 43c38a4f the model cannot output a code: its answer is categories + sentence numbers and the server computes level and code. Answers that also state a code: (a) SOAP note '99223 / High' -> card 99233 High Complexity; (b) SNF admission '99310 / High' -> 99306 High; (c) '99232 / Low' -> 99231 Low; (d) '99233 / High' with Moderate elements -> 99232 Moderate — the stated code never shows, the shown code and level always agree, in the template's family (pipeline 8/8, on the page 81/81 with S03). Malformed answers (plain-text CODE/LEVEL, unknown category, missing section, evidence not a list) fail closed with 'Billing model returned an invalid suggestion': the job retries, then the error card with retry (S20). Supersedes the old-build S26 result.

Evidence: 3 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (our scripted spec, not written yet): it needs a provider stub below ai/notes:suggestBilling on the local 4510 backend (runnerGaps 10) and the local admin helpers; dev has no admin key and the runner never injects a fault or mocks a model there, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 20…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
